problem: A single large root AGENTS file accumulates unrelated domain details, time-bounded owner exceptions and execution policy. Delegates receive unnecessary context and may confuse advisory model output with authoritative runtime/proof admission.
invariant: Keep a short universal agent policy and deterministic scoped context routing (task domain, active milestone, role, SSOT). Preserve detailed existing rules outside the root without loss. Keep orchestration contracts provider-neutral. Fail closed on missing context, out-of-stage work, duplicate domain ownership, untrusted admission claims, blocked issue prerequisites and contested exclusive runner/editor resources.

Unknown orchestration runtime remains documentation-only; no invented autonomous execution or fake CI result.
